opportunities.title: Luxury Interior Design WordPress Portfolio
opportunities.description: Creative WordPress Website for an International Luxury Interior Design Practice Project type: Website Design & Development Preferred platform: WordPress / Elementor Budget: €30 fixed price 1. Project Overview I am a Spanish Senior Interior Designer with over eight years of international experience in high-end residential, hospitality and commercial projects across Europe, Southeast Asia and the Middle East. I am looking for a creative web designer/developer to build a sophisticated, visually distinctive and responsive website for my independent interior design practice. The website should communicate understated luxury, creativity and strong design expertise. I want something visually memorable and editorial, rather than a generic corporate or standard portfolio template. My goal is to attract international clients looking for high-end interior design services, particularly luxury residential and hospitality projects. 2. Website Structure The website should include the following sections: HOME - Strong visual introduction and clear brand identity. - Full-screen or large-format architectural/interior imagery. - Short introduction and links to the three main portfolio categories. - Clear contact/enquiry call to action. HOSPITALITY & HOTELS - A dedicated portfolio section for hotels, resorts and hospitality projects. - A sophisticated visual identity inspired by brands such as Aman and the atmosphere of Azerai Ke Ga Bay Villas. - Emphasis on atmosphere, materials, storytelling and guest experience. LUXURY RESIDENTIAL - A dedicated section for luxury villas, houses and apartments. - Editorial, architectural and refined visual direction. - Inspiration from studios such as Ark Architects and the work of Dorra Ayadi. CREATIVE SPACES - A section for apartments, retail, commercial interiors and more experimental concepts. - A flexible presentation that reflects my creative approach and design style. ABOUT & SERVICES - Professional introduction and international experience. - Interior design, space planning, concept development, creative direction, materials and finishes, furniture and lighting specifications, 3D visualisation and technical documentation. - Remote design coordination with local architects, contractors and suppliers. CONTACT - Professional contact details and a simple enquiry form. - Links to my Instagram profile. 3. Visual Direction & Creative Approach The aesthetic should be warm, contemporary, minimal and sophisticated, with an editorial architectural feel. References: - https://www.aman.com/ - https://www.instagram.com/ark.architects/ - https://www.instagram.com/dorraayadi/ - https://www.instagram.com/lde.interiors/ I particularly appreciate creative websites featured on Awwwards, with thoughtful transitions, subtle animations, immersive imagery and distinctive typography. Possible effects include: - Scroll-triggered animations. - Smooth transitions and image scaling. - Subtle parallax effects. - Animated typography and microinteractions. - Creative portfolio layouts, potentially including horizontal scrolling. These are visual references, not a requirement to reproduce complex effects at any cost. Given the limited budget, I am open to using an existing high-quality theme or template and customising it creatively. The result should still feel distinctive and professional. Avoid generic corporate layouts, excessive decoration and overly dark or classical aesthetics. 4. Responsive Design The website must work properly on desktop, tablet and mobile. Mobile optimisation is essential. The mobile experience should be thoughtfully designed, not simply a reduced version of the desktop layout. 5. Portfolio Materials I can provide: - My existing portfolio: https://online.fliphtml5.com/mkwru/ccii/#p=1 - Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/id_manuelcuesta/ - Original 3D renders, design concepts and AI-assisted design projects. - Existing brand identity/logo, which can be shared once the project starts. You may use suitable Unsplash or other royalty-free images where necessary, particularly for the visual direction and luxury residential/hospitality atmosphere. Please use imagery consistent with the references above. Any AI-assisted or conceptual work must be presented accurately as concepts, not as completed built projects. 6. International Positioning & SEO The website must clearly communicate: Based in Spain · Working internationally · Remote interior design services worldwide. I can develop complete interior design projects remotely for clients regardless of their location, coordinating with local professionals when required. On-site visits and design supervision can be arranged separately, depending on project location and availability. They should not be presented as automatically included services. The initial SEO focus should be Spain, particularly luxury property destinations such as Marbella, Benahavís, Sotogrande, Mallorca, Ibiza, Madrid and Barcelona, while keeping the website suitable for international enquiries. Please include basic SEO: - SEO-friendly page structure and URLs. - Proper H1, H2 and H3 headings. - Page titles and meta descriptions. - Image alt text and image optimisation. - Fast loading and mobile-friendly performance. - Basic technical SEO setup. The website should be structured to support future expansion into other international markets. 7. Technical Requirements - WordPress preferred, ideally using Elementor. - Easy for me to update and manage independently. - Contact/enquiry form. - Instagram integration or clear social media links. - Responsive design. - Image optimisation and good loading performance. - Basic security and SSL configuration. - Full website ownership and administrator access transferred to me. Please avoid unnecessary paid themes, plugins or subscriptions. Any additional costs must be discussed and approved beforehand. 8. Domain & Hosting I do not currently have a domain or hosting. I would appreciate assistance researching, registering and configuring an affordable domain and hosting package. The domain and hosting accounts must be registered in my name, using my own email and contact details. I will pay these costs directly to the provider. They are separate from the website development budget. Please confirm any initial costs and renewal fees before recommending a provider or purchasing anything. No paid services should be purchased without my approval. 9. Budget & Working Approach My available budget for website development is €30 fixed price. Domain registration and hosting are separate costs paid directly by me. I understand that this budget does not allow for a fully bespoke website with extensive custom coding and advanced animations. I am therefore open to a suitable existing theme/template, free tools and a simplified but creative implementation. I am looking for someone who can achieve the best possible visual result within this budget, with the possibility of developing the website further in the future. Please make clear what you can realistically deliver for this price, which theme/plugins you intend to use, and whether any additional costs are involved. 10. What I Am Looking For I would particularly welcome applications from creative web designers, WordPress developers, students or emerging professionals with a good visual sense and an interest in architecture, interiors and luxury brands. Please include: - Examples of websites or portfolios you have designed. - Your proposed approach to this project. - Confirmation of what is included in your €30 bid. - Estimated delivery time. I am looking for a collaborative approach and a website that gives my interior design practice a distinctive, professional online presence.

opportunities.title: Social Media Manager, UGC Content Creator & Video Editor – Family Travel Brand
opportunities.description: Project Type: Long-term opportunity (starting with a paid trial) Category: Social Media Marketing | Video Editing | UGC Content Creation | Content Strategy Project Overview We are an Australian family of three launching a new travel brand across Instagram and TikTok. We have an extensive collection of travel photos, videos and drone footage from our adventures around the world, which we have recently finished organizing. We are looking for a creative, experienced freelancer who can help us turn our travel content into a successful, income-generating social media business. Our main goal is to monetize our content through UGC brand deals, paid collaborations, sponsored travel and affiliate marketing, while growing an engaged social media audience. We are not simply looking for someone to edit videos. We want someone who understands how to create engaging content, build a recognizable brand and develop opportunities for monetization. Our Content Focus Our brand will feature: - Family travel and adventure: Beautiful destinations, luxury resorts, affordable travel, unique experiences and drone footage. - Neurodivergent family travel: Sharing the challenges, rewards, funny moments and practical strategies involved in travelling the world as a neurodivergent family. - UGC content: Professional, authentic promotional videos designed to attract partnerships with hotels, resorts, tourism operators and travel brands. - Affiliate marketing: Featuring useful travel products, sensory-friendly products and other items relevant to neurodivergent families. Skills We're Looking For Ideally, our freelancer will have experience in: - Professional video and photo editing, including cinematic travel Reels. - Instagram and TikTok content creation and growth strategies. - UGC video creation and content suitable for brand advertising. - Social media marketing, storytelling, hooks, captions and trending content. - Brand partnerships, UGC portfolios and monetization strategies. - Affiliate marketing and integrating products naturally into content. - AI-assisted editing tools and efficient content production workflows. Experience working with travel, family or lifestyle brands would be highly regarded. Initial Trial Project We would like to begin with three professionally edited Reels to assess creativity, editing quality and understanding of our brand. 1. Cinematic Travel Reel: Showcasing beautiful destinations, resorts, adventures and drone footage. 2. Family Introduction Reel: Introducing our family and our neurodivergent travel experiences in a fun, relatable and engaging way. 3. UGC-Style Promotional Reel: Featuring a specific hotel, resort or travel experience, demonstrating the type of professional content we could create for paying brands. We will provide the original footage, photographs, drone videos and branding materials. We welcome creative suggestions regarding music, voiceovers, storytelling and presentation. Any music used for commercial UGC must have appropriate licensing. Long-Term Opportunity If the trial is successful, we hope to establish an ongoing working relationship. Our longer-term goals include: - Publishing approximately 5–7 high-quality Reels per week. - Growing our Instagram and TikTok accounts. - Building a professional UGC portfolio and media kit. - Developing strategies to attract paid UGC contracts and brand collaborations. - Exploring affiliate marketing opportunities. - Eventually expanding into social media management and brand outreach. We are particularly interested in someone who can take initiative, suggest creative ideas and help guide our strategy as the business develops. When Applying Please tell us: 1. What experience do you have with travel content, UGC creation and social media marketing? 2. Have you helped other creators or businesses secure paid UGC opportunities or monetize their content? 3. Can you share examples of Reels you've edited and UGC-style advertisements you've created? 4. Are you comfortable helping with content strategy and audience growth, rather than editing alone? 5. What would you charge for an initial three-Reel trial and an ongoing monthly arrangement? We're looking for a reliable, creative partner who is genuinely interested in helping us build a successful long-term travel content business. We look forward to hearing from you!

opportunities.title: Inventor RO Skid Modeling
opportunities.description: I need a skilled Inventor user to finish a plumbing-piping-electrical Reverse Osmosis skid assembly so that I can present it to my client in a clear, photo-realistic way. I already have partial Inventor, Revit and 3D Plant files for reference; your job is to turn these into a single, fully detailed assembly that shows every major component, support, valve and fitting exactly where it belongs. Scope • Start from the reference models I supply, verify dimensions against the photos and data inside the package, then complete any missing parts of the frame, pressure vessels, pumps, wiring trays, instruments and tie-in points. • Keep the model clean and parametrically organised—proper sub-assemblies, naming, and iProperties—because the file will later feed into Revit for coordination. • Add realistic materials and basic lighting so that rendered views are presentation-ready. Deliverables • Inventor .iam and all related .ipt files, fully constrained and error-free. • Two or three high-resolution still renders (PNG or JPEG) that I can drop straight into a slide deck. • Optional: a Revit-compatible export (STEP or native .rvt) if you already work in that environment. Acceptance criteria • No unresolved constraints, missing references or visibility errors when the model opens in Inventor 2022+. • All pipe routes, electrical conduits and supports match the connection points called out in the reference package. • File size and feature complexity kept reasonable so it will load smoothly in Revit. If this first skid goes smoothly I have additional RO trains and pump skids coming up, so I’m looking for someone who can slot into my workflow long term. Let’s talk timing and any clarifications you need to get started.

opportunities.title: Saudi Expat Nanny Ads Setup
opportunities.description: The task is to launch and optimise a Facebook Click-to-WhatsApp campaign that puts our caregiver agency in front of expatriate nannies and live-in caregivers already living and working across Saudi Arabia. The single success metric is a steady flow of qualified WhatsApp enquiries that our agency team can immediately handle. Scope of work I’ll give you access to our Business Manager and the dedicated WhatsApp number tied to the agency. From there you will: • Research and define the right audience segments (country of origin, current city in KSA, work status, language, interests). • Craft persuasive copy and visuals that speak directly to nannies and caregivers, encouraging them to start a WhatsApp chat for job placement and support. • Build, launch and monitor at least three ad sets, split-testing creative, placement and budget allocation. • Install and configure the Facebook pixel and conversion events so we can measure cost per enquiry with accuracy. • Optimise daily for lower cost per WhatsApp click and higher chat-initiation rate. • Provide a short weekly report covering spend, enquiries generated, and the next optimisation steps. Acceptance criteria • Campaign is live inside our account and fully owned by us. • Tracking works and reports match WhatsApp message counts. • Minimum of 50 genuine WhatsApp chats from nannies/caregivers in the first full week, with cost per enquiry trending down in subsequent optimisations. Tools likely involved: Facebook Ads Manager, Business Manager, WhatsApp Business API, Pixel, Creative Suite (Canva, Adobe, or similar). Everything—strategy notes, creatives, and reports—must be handed over in editable format so we can continue scaling once the target numbers are hit.

opportunities.title: 24/7 Low-Risk Bitcoin Trading Bot
opportunities.description: I need a production-ready trading bot that runs around the clock on the Coinswitch spot market and trades only Bitcoin. Low risk is my top priority, so the strategy must combine real-time news sentiment with solid technical and functional analysis before placing any order. In other words, the bot should read global headlines, measure market mood, check key indicators (moving averages, RSI, volume, etc.), and then decide whether to buy, sell, or sit out—no emotional trades, no leverage, just disciplined spot execution. I expect automatic position sizing, configurable stop-loss and take-profit levels, and a clear way for me to tweak risk parameters without diving into the code. The system must be capable of running 24/7 on a VPS or cloud instance, reconnecting to the Coinswitch API after any outage, and logging every action so I can audit decisions later. opportunities.title: Delaware Architect Stamp Mixed-Use Plans
opportunities.description: My 5,000 sq ft new-build combines S-1 garage/storage on the ground level with R-3 residential units above. I have already produced complete architectural, structural, electrical, plumbing, and mechanical drawings, filled out the local forms, and performed an initial IRC/IBC code check. What still remains is a Delaware-licensed architect’s final review, any corrections needed to satisfy state and county requirements, and your wet stamp / embossed seal on the full permit package so I can obtain a new-construction permit. Scope • Review the entire permit set, including drawings, calculations, forms, and code analyses. • Note and resolve any compliance issues you find. • Provide stamped and signed hard-copy plan sets (as many as the county requires) plus matching PDFs. • Supply a brief code-review letter or cover sheet confirming conformance with applicable Delaware amendments to the IBC, IRC, IEBC, and local zoning. All files are ready in AutoCAD and PDF; courier or in-person drop-off of the sealed plans is acceptable. Turnaround within two weeks is ideal, but I can adjust if your professional schedule needs a little more time. Will provide all needed information as available.

opportunities.title: Vintage Streetwear Tee & Hoodie Design
opportunities.description: I’m building a premium streetwear label inspired by the elevated aesthetic of brands like Raastah, and I’m ready to shape our very first drop: oversized T-shirts and hoodies finished with a vintage, washed-out, slightly distressed vibe. I need a fashion designer who can translate that direction into a cohesive micro-collection that feels instantly collectible and sets the tone for everything that follows. Here’s what I’m looking for: • Concept development that locks in colour stories, wash effects, and graphic mood. • Original artwork or placement ideas that give each piece a worn-in attitude without looking gimmicky. • Full tech packs—measurements for an oversized fit, construction notes, trim call-outs, fabric weights, and detailed wash instructions. • Fabric and dye recommendations that achieve authentic fading and soft hand-feel while keeping quality high. • Production-ready files (Adobe Illustrator/Photoshop; 300 DPI) plus any mock-ups or 3D visualisations you normally supply. When you respond, share a detailed project proposal: your process, timelines, and any past examples of washed or distressed streetwear you’ve taken from sketch to sample. That clarity will help me see how we’d work together and how you’ll manage the vintage treatment so it scales in production. I’m ready to start as soon as I find the right fit and intend to move quickly into sampling, so please outline realistic milestones from concept sign-off to factory-ready tech packs. Looking forward to seeing how you’ll bring this first collection to life. Additionally, I want to open a premium clothing brand competing with a prestigious brand, focusing on creating products with a vintage yet aesthetic look. The designs should strike a balance between vintage appeal and modern acceptance, ensuring they resonate well with the targeted audience.

opportunities.title: Design Luxury Streetwear Tee Collection
opportunities.description: I am building a premium streetwear label that will debut in Pakistan and, once established, roll out to global markets. The line blends high-quality fabrics with dark, edgy and experimental cuts—think oversized tees and tops re-imagined through unusual silhouettes, refined detailing and a contemporary luxury attitude. For this first drop I want you to take complete creative ownership of the oversized T-shirt segment: sketch distinctive shapes, propose fabrications that feel elevated yet wearable, and translate each concept into production-ready files. Mastery of Adobe Illustrator (or similar), tech-pack creation, pattern drafting and an understanding of high-end knit fabrics is essential. Familiarity with 3D tools such as CLO3D or Browzwear will be a plus because it helps visualise those unconventional cuts before sampling. Deliverables I need to see: • Mood and colour boards that capture the brand’s dark, experimental tone • 8–10 original oversized tee designs with front, back and detail views • Complete tech packs and graded spec sheets ready for factory hand-off • Print/embellishment artwork files and fabric recommendations • Guidance through the first sample round to ensure fit and finish match the vision Please attach a detailed project proposal outlining your creative process, timeline, key milestones and any comparable streetwear work you have produced. I’m ready to begin as soon as I find the right collaborator, and I look forward to seeing how you can push premium streetwear forward with this collection.

opportunities.title: Luxury Streetwear Collection Design
opportunities.description: I’m building a premium streetwear label that will debut in Pakistan and, in time, grow onto the global stage. The vision is clear: elevated fabrics, distinctive silhouettes, refined detailing and a contemporary luxury attitude that fuses modern Pakistani influences with worldwide streetwear culture. For the first release I want a full line—tops, bottoms and accessories—designed as a cohesive yet commercially viable drop. Think heavyweight jersey tees, cropped hoodies, tailored joggers, statement outerwear, caps and small leather goods that all share a signature design language. Your role begins at concept and ends with production-ready documentation. I’ll rely on you to translate mood-board ideas into sketches, develop fabrics and trims, and create tech packs that factories can quote and sample from. Familiarity with Adobe Illustrator, Photoshop and CLO 3D, plus hands-on knowledge of premium cotton, recycled nylon and YKK hardware, will be highly valued. Experience with Pakistan-based manufacturing partners is a bonus. Deliverables • Mood boards & range plan • Detailed tech packs (measurements, trims, BOM) • Fabric and trim sourcing guidance • Digital mock-ups or 3D renders for line review • Size charts and grading suggestions • Sampling feedback until each piece is production ready The timeline is flexible; I care more about precision and originality than speed. Please share your portfolio—especially work that blends cultural references with luxury streetwear—and outline how you’d guide this collection from concept through sample approval and toward an international launch.

opportunities.title: Vertical Pump 3D Sales Kit
opportunities.description: I need a visually compelling, technically accurate package that turns our existing Autodesk Inventor models and internal Cascade documentation into a customer-ready sales kit for vertical pumps. The end goal is simple: give our sales teams a clear, engaging way to explain the product to engineers and other technical buyers. Scope of work • Build animated 3D product views that can run in PowerPoint, the web, and on tablets—Autodesk Inventor Studio, 3DVia Composer, or an equivalent pipeline is fine as long as the final files are lightweight and easy to replay. • 3DVia Composer output is required. We need the content published to browser-based WebGL/gITF viewer • Produce an exploded-view sequence highlighting the main parts and service points; supply both high-resolution stills and an interactive version (Composer SMG or similar). • Draft a concise comparison section that lays out key features and benefits in plain language supported by call-outs, short captions, and clean visuals. • Add content from the Sales Kit to the Operation and Maintenance Manual • Use the same content to create a training presentation / video. Source material will be provided: native Inventor assemblies, step files if needed, and our current internal manuals. All dimensional data, tolerances, and service notes must remain intact; please keep file naming consistent with our engineering vault. Acceptance criteria — Animations run smoothly at 1080p, 30 fps without texture flicker. — 3DVia Composer output is smooth running in browser-based WebGL/gITF viewer — Exploded views clearly label each sub-assembly and match our part numbers. — Slide deck (PPTX) is under 100 MB and ready for a non-technical salesperson to present without extra editing. — All deliverables pass a final technical review with our engineering lead. This is a focused project, not an open-ended marketing exercise—accuracy and clarity are critical. If you have a proven workflow for translating CAD data into clean sales visuals, let’s get started.

Please replicate every booth exactly as it appears—sizes, shapes, and numbering must match the PDF with no substitutions or renumbering. In addition to the booths, be sure the aisles, main entrances, emergency exits, and restroom locations are all clearly defined on the drawing. If anything in the PDF is unclear, let me know before proceeding so the final file comes back correct the first time.

opportunities.title: Custom 3D Printed Electronics Enclosure
opportunities.description: I need a compact, 3D-print-ready enclosure that neatly houses an Orange Pi Zero 3, its heat sink, a 2.8-inch LCD, a card reader, an on/off switch, and a reset pin. The unit will spend its time both indoors and outdoors for short periods, so it should shrug off light rain, dust, and curious fingers without looking like a watertight submarine. Key functional goals • The heat sink sits against the rear wall, so I want a pattern of perforated slots behind it to let hot air escape while still keeping splashes out. • The LCD and card reader must be visible and usable without opening the box; everything else can stay protected inside. A clear window or open bezel on the front panel works as long as it keeps drizzle away. • A simple top or front cover should fasten with screws so I can pop it off for maintenance yet seal snugly day-to-day. A shallow lip with a gasket or a printed TPU seal is fine; I’m open to your suggestions on the exact approach. I’ll provide precise component dimensions once we start. You design the enclosure, check tolerances for FDM printing in PETG or ASA, and supply: 1. Editable CAD file (STEP or Fusion 360 preferred) 2. Print-ready STL files, organized by part 3. A short assembly note or exploded view so I know where each board and screw goes Everything should be oriented for minimal supports and use common M3 hardware where possible. If you can add subtle branding or labels in the model, that’s a plus but not essential. Let me know what software you’ll model in and any clarifying questions you have about fit, airflow, or mounting. I’m ready to get this printed and installed quickly. Would prefer Southern California location so I can meet up and get the placement correct.

opportunities.title: Sports Mouthguard 3D Redesign
opportunities.description: (No AI) Hi, I’m looking for a 3D/product designer who can modify or recreate an existing mouthguard design. I already have the visual design and branding direction for the product, which I’ll provide as reference images. The main issue I need corrected is the physical shape/proportions of the mouthguard. At the moment, the front section has quite a large/open gap and sits too low. I want the front outer wall/lip to extend higher so that the gap is much more closed, similar to the competitor reference images I’ve attached. However, I don’t want it to become excessively thick or bulky, the overall profile should still look clean, realistic and suitable for an actual sports mouthguard. The GRID design, colour placement and general shape should remain recognisable. The competitor images are mainly references for the **height, coverage and more closed front profile**, rather than something to copy exactly. I’m open to whichever method you think is most appropriate, modifying/rebuilding the existing design or recreating it properly as a new 3D model. Before I hire you, could you please let me know: • Whether you can realistically achieve this from the references provided • How you would approach changing/recreating the shape • Which software you would use (Blender, Fusion 360, SolidWorks, Rhino, ZBrush, etc.) • Whether the final model would be properly editable • What files you would deliver (STEP/STL/OBJ/FBX or other appropriate formats) • Whether you can also produce realistic product renders afterwards Please also tell me if you think there is a better way to achieve the shape shown in the references. I’d rather know your actual approach before starting than simply receive a yes.

opportunities.description: Company: Makeitonline E-Commerce Studio (Pluxo Media) Role: B2B Cold Calling & Tele-Sales Specialist Job Type: Freelance / Remote / Project-Based Payout: ₹200 per successful client closing/onboarding (Uncapped Earnings) About the Role Makeitonline E-Commerce Studio is a fast-growing E-Commerce Enablement Agency. We help traditional manufacturers and super-wholesalers (Jewellery, Fashion, & Accessories) launch and scale their Direct-to-Consumer (D2C) stores on Amazon, Flipkart, and Meesho with zero upfront cost. We are looking for a highly persuasive, fluent, and result-driven B2B Cold Calling Specialist to contact factory owners and manufacturers, pitch our zero-risk onboarding model, and successfully close and onboard them. Handle client objections with confidence and guide them to share 2–3 product sample photos on WhatsApp for a quick demo. Follow up and successfully onboard the client to close the deal. Requirements & QualificationsExcellent Hindi communication skills with a professional, executive tone. Prior experience in B2B Tele-Sales, Cold Calling, or Inside Sales (E-commerce background is a plus).Strong objection-handling, persuasion, and negotiation skills. Self-disciplined, target-driven mindset suitable for remote work. Growth Opportunity: Priority consideration for long-term fixed retainer roles based on performance.

opportunities.title: Commission-based website selling (SALE)
opportunities.description: Find Clients for Web Design Studio (Commission-Based) Description: Wenoy is an independent web studio based in Bangalore, India. We build professional websites for small and medium businesses in India and abroad. We are looking for a Business Development Partner who can bring us paying clients. How you find clients is up to you. Cold outreach (email, LinkedIn, Instagram DMs, WhatsApp, cold calls), your personal network, referrals, social media, walking into local shops, or any other honest method that works for you. What you will do: • Find business owners who need a new website or a redesign (salons, clinics, restaurants, shops, furniture, logistics, etc.) • Reach out to them by cold outreach or any method you prefer • Introduce Wenoy and connect the client with us • Help close the deal What we will do: • Give the quote and finalize the price • Design, build and launch the website • Handle all client support and changes • Share samples of our work to help your pitch Commission (first project only): • India clients: 20% of project value • Foreign clients: 30% of project value Paid after the client has paid us. Rules: • Use honest outreach only. No spam, fake claims or misleading messages. • Do not quote prices or promise features. We handle that. • Share every lead with us before going further, so it is registered under your name. • Terms are confirmed in a short written agreement. Requirements: • Good English communication (Hindi/Kannada/Arabic is a plus) • Experience in sales, cold outreach, lead generation, marketing or freelancing • A network of business owners is a big plus To apply, please answer: 1. Which method will you use to find clients (cold email, LinkedIn, calls, network, other)? 2. Which countries or industries do you know best? 3. Have you sold web or digital services before? Share examples. No investment needed. No fixed target

opportunities.title: Charming 3D Nursery Rhyme Videos
opportunities.description: I need a series of full-length 3D animated nursery rhyme videos designed specifically for babies and toddlers (0–3). Each rhyme should be fully produced from start to finish: you will build the characters and environments in 3D, compose an original, catchy melody, record gentle vocals, and weave in age-appropriate sound effects. My priority is simple, colourful storytelling that keeps very young viewers engaged and soothed. Smooth, slow camera moves, bright yet soft palettes, and clear facial expressions are essential. Audio must be mixed cleanly so the lyrics are easy to follow and the overall volume is comfortable for small ears. Deliverables for each rhyme: • 1920×1080 MP4 video (or higher on request) • Separate WAV stems for music, vocals, and SFX • Source project files for both animation and audio (Blender/Maya, Logic/Pro Tools, etc.) Please include a short note on your workflow, preferred 3D and audio tools, and a link to at least one previous child-focused animation with original music. If you already have sample characters or style frames, feel free to attach them so we can quickly align on look and feel.

opportunities.title: Project Governance & Reporting Standardization
opportunities.description: I need an expert who can bring order and consistency to my scattered project information. At the moment I track some initiatives in Excel, others in Smartsheet, and a few more through Teams and SharePoint. My first priority is to organise and standardise every file, meeting-related document and project process so that reporting later becomes friction-free. Scope of work • Design a clear, repeatable governance framework: common project states, reporting cadence, and approval rules that apply to every portfolio item. • Build the supporting file structure inside SharePoint (or the platform you recommend) and map existing Excel, Smartsheet and Teams content into it with clean naming conventions. • Provide meeting and action-tracking templates that align with the new framework so I can capture notes the same way every time. • Prepare the ground for future automation: your structure must be compatible with Power Automate triggers and ready for a Power BI executive dashboard that will eventually pull from all sources—even when formats differ. • Show me how AI can draft follow-up emails and reminders from the data we capture. Acceptance criteria 1. A documented governance guide covering project states, mandatory reports, and escalation paths. 2. A working folder hierarchy populated with my current files and the agreed naming standards. 3. Ready-to-use templates for meetings, decisions, and action logs. 4. A short demo proving that at least one automation flow (e.g., automatic reminder email) runs successfully against the new structure. 5. Step-by-step instructions so I can maintain and scale the setup on my own. Tools already in use: Microsoft 365 (Power BI, Power Automate, SharePoint, Planner), Smartsheet, Teams, and plenty of Excel files. If you have solid experience harmonising mixed environments and can keep things lean and pragmatic, I’d like to start right away and move quickly to visible results.

opportunities.title: Land Lead Gen Marketing
opportunities.description: I’m ready to scale sales for our residential and farm-style land plots and I need an experienced digital marketer who has already cracked real-estate lead generation in India. The first campaigns must promote plots in both Indore and Ujjain, so your targeting, copy and creatives should speak to buyers familiar with these cities and their growth corridors. WHO WE’RE TRYING TO REACH • Investors looking for future value growth • People interested in farm or weekend plots WHAT MUST STAND OUT IN EVERY AD & ON THE LANDING PAGE • Price, plot size and clear payment options • Exact location, nearby roads and upcoming development plans • All legal papers, approvals and clean ownership details YOUR CORE TASKS 1. Set up and optimise Meta Ads (Facebook / Instagram) and Google Ads lead campaigns geared toward low cost-per-enquiry. 2. Build or refine a fast, mobile-first landing page that captures leads and syncs to a basic CRM. 3. Implement an instant WhatsApp / phone follow-up flow so leads never go cold. 4. Produce scroll-stopping ad creatives—images, short reels and carousels that suit each placement. 5. Review performance with me every week, adjust targeting, creative and budgets, and keep CPL trending down. TOOLS YOU’LL PROBABLY TOUCH Meta Ads Manager, Google Ads, WordPress or Webflow (for the landing page), basic CRM (Zoho, HubSpot or similar), Google Analytics, WhatsApp Business API, Zapier/Make for automation. TIMELINE & ENGAGEMENT This is an ongoing engagement for a minimum of three months; ad spend is separate and funded by me. SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE • Consistent flow of qualified enquiries from Indore and Ujjain • Clear CPL benchmarks met or beaten each week • Landing page conversion rate trending upward • Smooth WhatsApp hand-off so my sales team can close quickly If you’ve driven plot or real-estate leads before, especially in Madhya Pradesh, send over your best case studies showing leads generated and cost per lead achieved. Let’s talk strategy and get the campaigns live.

WHO WE’RE TRYING TO REACH • Investors looking for future value growth • People interested in farm or weekend plots WHAT MUST STAND OUT IN EVERY AD & ON THE LANDING PAGE • Price, plot size and clear payment options • Exact location, nearby roads and upcoming development plans • All legal papers, approvals and clean ownership details YOUR CORE TASKS 1. Set up and optimise Meta Ads (Facebook / Instagram) and Google Ads lead campaigns geared toward low cost-per-enquiry. 2. Build or refine a fast, mobile-first landing page that captures leads and syncs to a basic CRM. 3. Implement an instant WhatsApp / phone follow-up flow so leads never go cold. 4. Produce scroll-stopping ad creatives—images, short reels and carousels that suit each placement. 5. Review performance with me every week, adjust targeting, creative and budgets, and keep CPL trending down. TOOLS YOU’LL PROBABLY TOUCH Meta Ads Manager, Google Ads, WordPress or Webflow (for the landing page), basic CRM (Zoho, HubSpot or similar), Google Analytics, WhatsApp Business API, Zapier/Make for automation. TIMELINE & ENGAGEMENT This is an ongoing engagement for a minimum of three months; ad spend is separate and funded by me. SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE • Consistent flow of qualified enquiries from Indore and Ujjain • Clear CPL benchmarks met or beaten each week • Landing page conversion rate trending upward • Smooth WhatsApp hand-off so my sales team can close quickly If you’ve driven plot or real-estate leads before, especially in Madhya Pradesh, send over your best case studies showing leads generated and cost per lead achieved. Let’s talk strategy and get the campaigns live."

opportunities.title: Optimasi Proses Persetujuan Tim
opportunities.description: Saya ingin mempercepat alur persetujuan dan koordinasi antar tim di perusahaan kami. Saat ini, prosesnya masih terfragmentasi—terlalu banyak langkah manual, komunikasi tersebar di beberapa kanal, dan tidak ada jalur yang benar-benar jelas tentang siapa menyetujui apa dan kapan. Akibatnya, pekerjaan tertahan dan target waktu mundur. Saya membutuhkan seorang ahli optimasi proses kerja bisnis yang dapat: • Memetakan alur persetujuan yang berjalan sekarang, lengkap dengan hambatan utamanya. • Merancang proses baru yang lebih ringkas dan terukur, beserta diagram flow atau SOP singkat. • Menyediakan rekomendasi tool digital (mis. workflow automation, project management, atau approval software) yang cocok dengan skala kami. • Menyusun rencana implementasi tahap awal agar tim dapat mulai mengadopsi proses baru tanpa gangguan besar pada operasional harian. Keberhasilan pekerjaan ini diukur dari tercapainya jalur persetujuan yang lebih singkat, transparansi status yang mudah dipantau, serta potensi penghematan waktu nyata bagi tiap tim yang terlibat. Jika Anda memiliki pengalaman merampingkan proses lintas-departemen dan familiar dengan pendekatan continuous improvement seperti Lean, BPMN, atau sejenisnya, saya menantikan solusi praktis Anda.
opportunities.contractor_info: Demandante verificado en Freelancer.co (Anuncio #40810149, publicado hace 13 horas (hoy)). Presupuesto ofrecido: USD 15 - 25.

opportunities.title: Pruebas Integrales de Ciberseguridad
opportunities.description: Quiero poner a prueba tanto la página web pública como nuestro CRM interno. Necesito que se ejecute una batería completa de pruebas de seguridad sobre todas sus funciones: lógica de negocio, control de acceso, inyección de código, gestión de sesiones, cifrado de datos y cualquier otra superficie de ataque relevante. Para las pruebas facilitaré acceso de usuario normal a ambos entornos. Con esas credenciales deberás identificar cualquier vulnerabilidad que un atacante pudiera aprovechar sin privilegios elevados. Entregables esperados: • Informe técnico con cada hallazgo, gravedad, riesgo real y demostración paso a paso. • Recomendaciones claras de mitigación o corrección. • Sesión online con nuestro equipo de soporte para revisar los fallos y guiarlos en la implementación de las soluciones. Valoro experiencia en OWASP, pruebas de penetración web, análisis de aplicaciones CRM y generación de informes ejecutivos y técnicos.

opportunities.title: Editores de Video con Ia para Anuncios de Respuesta Directa en E-co...
opportunities.description: Buscamos editores de video con ia para crear anuncios de respuesta directa en formato ugc para nuestras marcas de suplementos y cuidado de la piel. A partir de un guion y un brief creativo, generarás las tomas con IA y las editarás para entregar el anuncio final. Requisitos - Experiencia comprobada creando anuncios ugc con ia para marcas de suplementos y cuidado de la piel. Incluye ejemplos, por favor. - Excelente nivel de inglés hablado. Hablarás con el equipo sobre guiones, cambios de edición y comentarios. - Experiencia práctica con Seedance. - Experiencia usando Claude para planificar tomas y redactar prompts. - Buen dominio de la edición de video: ganchos iniciales, ritmo, subtítulos, voz en off y diseño sonoro. Cubrimos todos los créditos de Seedance y Claude, así que no pagarás nada de tu bolsillo por las herramientas. Cómo postularte Envíanos un mensaje con una breve presentación, un poco sobre tu experiencia y enlaces a anuncios ugc con ia que hayas hecho para marcas de suplementos o cuidado de la piel. Te pondremos a trabajar. Categoría: Diseño y Multimedia Subcategoría: Crear o editar video ¿Qué necesitas?: Video nuevo a partir de grabaciones existentes

opportunities.title: Plataforma de comercio inmersivo en metaverso
opportunities.description: Estoy trabajando en una plataforma inmersiva que busca revolucionar el comercio digital. Este mundo digital permitirá a los usuarios crear y personalizar sus propias tiendas virtuales como si fueran mundos, estableciendo sus reglas únicas y ofreciendo todo tipo de productos para vender y comprar. La plataforma incluirá: - Creación de tiendas virtuales completamente personalizables con plantillas, escaparates dinámicos y herramientas de analítica básica. - Flujos avanzados de compra-venta, gestión de inventarios y una pasarela de pagos virtual integrada. - Experiencias sociales, incluyendo interacción entre avatares, chat de voz y gestos con seguimiento manual. - Compatibilidad multiplataforma para dispositivos WebXR, Meta Quest, HTC Vive, PCVR optimizados con motores como Unity o Unreal Engine. Busco soporte técnico para construir este sistema. Entrego wireframes iniciales y listado de funcionalidades clave. Necesito código limpio, documentación bien detallada e informes técnicos sobre las especificaciones del proyecto. ¡Si tienes experiencia similar será un plus!
opportunities.contractor_info: Demandante verificado en Freelancer.co (Anuncio #40808907, publicado hace 1 día). Presupuesto ofrecido: USD 375 - 750.

Busco soporte técnico para construir este sistema. Entrego wireframes iniciales y listado de funcionalidades clave. opportunities.title: Asistente WhatsApp Atención a Clientes
opportunities.description: Quiero implementar un asistente virtual en WhatsApp Business que atienda las consultas diarias de mis clientes de forma automática y, cuando detecte un caso complejo, lo redirija a un operador humano sin perder el historial de la conversación. Qué debe hacer el asistente • Reconocer preguntas habituales y responderlas en el mismo hilo. • Consultar la información de cada cliente sobre pedidos, reservas o citas para dar detalles de estado, horarios o cambios. • Escalar cualquier consulta fuera de lo previsto a un número o chat interno con un agente humano, indicando el motivo y adjuntando el contexto. Fuente de datos disponible Toda la información de pedidos y reservas está dispersa en las propias conversaciones de WhatsApp o en registros manuales. Necesito una propuesta que extraiga esos datos de manera estructurada o, si lo prefieres, plantee una forma sencilla de que yo alimente al bot con esa información (por ejemplo, mediante etiquetas, mensajes con formato o una pequeña base externa). Entrego • Ejemplos de conversaciones reales para entrenar al bot. • Lista de respuestas modelo y reglas de escalamiento que ya utilizo manualmente. Espero • Configuración completa en la plataforma que sugieras (WhatsApp Business API, Twilio, ManyChat, Dialogflow, etc.). • Entrenamiento inicial y documentación breve para que pueda ajustar nuevas FAQs. • Pruebas funcionen en español con casos reales y demostración de la derivación a humano. • Breve guía de mantenimiento y soporte para los primeros ajustes. Si tienes experiencia previa creando chatbots o integraciones en WhatsApp y puedes trabajar con la información no estructurada que describo, me encantará conocer tu enfoque y tiempo estimado.
